import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')

# Filter the data for each region
region_revenue = df.groupby('region')['revenue'].max().reset_index()

# Plot the revenue for each region
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(region_revenue['region'], region_revenue['revenue'])
plt.xlabel('Region')
plt.ylabel('Revenue')
plt.title('Maximum Revenue per Region')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
